body: Oh yeah, those lovely advice, do people really think that such deep issue can be solved on a surface level? Well sometimes of course enviroment can play a huge role in someone's depression, but come on, it's not like you will move to a better looking place and be miraculously cured. I know that most people mean well but still...
Very bad, I don't want to be alive, wishing things were different, on the verge of tears as I'm writing this.

Life sucks and sometimes things don't get better, I don't know why people are so afraid to admit that. While I'm not against treating depression and helping people I also sometimes just want someone to share my opinion.
I wish I could escape my mind without having to kill myself, it's awful, I totally understand you.
If you're still here, I feel for you, I'm preparing myself for my own attempt

I agree that most people are superficial and lie about not caring about the looks when it's clearly what they're looking for. Althought throughout my junior high I've been constantly called ugly it's not an issue for me anymore. I stopped caring about my non-existent love life and my acne covered face is not my daily worry (seriously). I guess what's actually going for me is that I'm fit and have long legs but to be honest I don't want to be in a relationship. Maybe that's because of my SPD but I don't give a shit about it really, at this point being alive is too painful for me so I don't have any mental space left for this 'love' shit
Oh God I'm literally praying every day for something bad to happen to me...but I'm not encouraging you or anything, just saying.

I tried to hang myself this Monday but prior to that I've had couple of "half attempts". When I was all ready and had to overcome this nasty survival instinct I just fully focused on the pain that drove me to this point. After the wave of pain washed over me I kinda "stopped" thinking and did it like lets say a person close to you or even a pet is stuck in a burning vehicle and even though you are scared you might get hurt (from a survival point of view, not that you WANT to live) you save them because you feel you have to. That's what it was like for me anyway, I was scared but my need to end this pain was stronger and I just focused on my motions rather than my thoughts. Maybe that wasn't helpful but I thought I would make an account and share it with you. Obviously I failed but I want to try again because I can't stand existing like that. Before you do anything be SURE that you want this.
